title: Mkpụrụ Obi Ahụhụ nke Naịl
intro: N'oge a nke oke mmegbu, mgbe onye ọchịchị aka ike chịrị ala ahụ n'obi ọjọọ zuru oke, otu mkpụrụ obi họọrọ ụzọ okwukwe karịa nkasi obi nke eze. Onye a bi n'obi ike mana ọ chọtara eziokwu n'ozi nke onye amụma dị umeala n'obi. Njem ha ga-aghọ ihe mmụta na-adịghị agwụ agwụ n'inwe ndidi, ịchụ àjà, na nkwenye siri ike. Ị̀ pụrụ ịchọpụta onye a pụrụ iche nke họọrọ ihe ụtọ Chineke karịa ọnọdụ ụwa?
clues: Ebi m n'obí eze dị ike nke ukwuu, mana obi m chọtara eziokwu n'ozi dị umeala n'obi.
Ahọpụtara m ịgbaso nduzi nke Moses, ebe m maara ihe ga-esi na ya pụta.
Alụrụ m onye ọchịchị aka ike kacha ike n'oge m, mana ajụkwara m chi ụgha ya.
Ahụhụ m siri ike, ebe a tara m ahụhụ maka okwukwe m nwere n'otu Chineke.
Okwukwe m agbanweghị, ọbụlagodi mgbe m chere ahụhụ kacha njọ ihu.
Onyenwe m nwere obi ụtọ maka ndidi m wee họrọ m ka m bụrụ ebe dị ùgwù na Paradaịs.

identity.label: Ònye ka m bụ?
options: Nwanne nwanyị nke onye amụma Musa
Eze nwanyị nke Ijipt oge ochie

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Ịlụ ọgụ n'ihi Allah na ndị agha
Izute Fero ma kwupụta okwukwe ya
trial.answer: Izute Fero ma kwupụta okwukwe ya

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: M ghọrọ onye amụma mgbe ọtụtụ afọ gasịrị
E nyere ya ikike ịchị Ijipt
Allah gọziri ya ma sọpụrụ ya
outcome.answer: Allah gọziri ya ma sọpụrụ ya

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
